I can't remember the last time I felt so strongly compelled to write a positive review.
I don't consider myself to have a problem with doom scrolling or screentime for the most part, but I have one digital vice - YouTube. I have premium and it's probably my favourite entertainment platform.
I noticed that my Screentime was creeping up over time into numbers that I wasn't comfortable with.
With all other apps I was wasting time with and knew they werent bringing me any value, I simply deleted them, cold turkey, about a year ago and have no regrets. But YouTube felt different, I do get genuine value from it whether that be entertainment, educational or practical. The problem was the volume and lack of intentionality.
Although it's early days I can whole heartedly say that one-sec has completely changed the dynamic and feels like the perfect solution I was missing all this time. In just one week my Screentime reduced by 45% while feeling like I wasn't even trying. Through a combination of blocking schedules and interventions, the frequency and duration I spend on YT has dropped dramatically and I can feel better habits forming already.
Often you really do only need the intervention, but I do like having the scheduled block features to stop me from checking work apps when I'm off the clock.
As others point out, the setup is a bit unconventional and less straightforward than some of the alternatives. But it is absolutely worth it, and the instructions are still clear enough.
More than happy to pay the modest annual fee for such a high-impact and well thought out experience.
Delight to use. Does its job really well. Highly recommend and easily worth the money in productivity gains for me

The only app that has managed to create a lasting break in the habit of opening social media apps. Since using this app my work productivity has improved, and I’ve gained back 90 mins of commuting time per day which I’ve spent writing a new screenplay.
I first used the app in October of 2024 and I have no regrets . My usage went down 97% ! From 326 attempts to open per week to just 7. I will now let this app go, but it has served me well.
